mapper.sql: SELECT g.id grant_id,g.membership_id member_id,g.generation,g.group_id,g.role_id,r.role_code,r.version role_version,r.capabilities_json, g.scope,s.rule_json,g.source_type,g.source_id,g.valid_from::text,g.valid_to::text,g.state grant_state, CASE WHEN g.state='REVOKED' THEN CASE WHEN rec.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND p.state='READY' AND d.state='READY' THEN 'REVOKED' ELSE 'REVOKING' END WHEN g.valid_to <=clock_timestamp() THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN NOT a.enabled OR t.status<>'ACTIVE' THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN g.source_type<>'GROUP' AND (m.status<>'ACTIVE' OR m.generation<>g.generation OR u.status<>'ACTIVE' OR m.valid_from>clock_timestamp() OR m.valid_to<=clock_timestamp()) THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.capability_state c JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text(r.capabilities_json::jsonb) cap ON cap.value=c.capability WHERE c.application_id=g.application_id AND c.disabled) THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.directory_source src WHERE src.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND src.quarantined) THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN p.state='BLOCKED' OR d.state='BLOCKED' THEN 'APPLY_FAILED' WHEN g.state<>'ACTIVE' OR g.zed_token IS NULL OR rec.operation_id IS NULL OR p.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'READY' OR d.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'READY' OR p.desired_epoch<>p.applied_epoch OR d.desired_epoch<>d.applied_epoch OR g.valid_from>clock_timestamp() THEN 'PENDING_APPLY' WHEN g.source_type='GROUP' THEN 'GROUP_CHECK_REQUIRED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END effective_state, g.version grant_version,rec.operation_id,coalesce(p.state,'LEGACY') policy_state,coalesce(d.state,'LEGACY') directory_state FROM auth_governance.access_grant g JOIN auth_governance.role_version r ON r.id=g.role_id AND r.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND r.application_id=g.application_id AND r.environment=g.environment JOIN auth_governance.tenant_application a ON a.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND a.application_id=g.application_id AND a.environment=g.environment JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=g.tenant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.grant_scope s ON s.grant_id=g.id AND s.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND s.application_id=g.application_id AND s.environment=g.environment LEFT JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.id=g.membership_id AND m.tenant_id=g.tenant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.policy_partition p ON p.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND p.application_id=g.application_id AND p.environment=g.environment LEFT JOIN auth_governance.directory_fence d ON d.tenant_id=g.tenant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.projection_grant_receipt rec ON rec.grant_id=g.id AND rec.grant_version=g.version WHERE g.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND g.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND g.environment=#{p.environment}
mapper.select: AND (g.membership_id=#{member} AND g.generation=#{generation} OR g.source_type='GROUP' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.directory_group_member gm WHERE gm.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND gm.group_id=g.group_id AND gm.membership_id=#{member} AND gm.generation=#{generation} AND gm.current)) AND g.id >#{after} ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 101

AND (g.membership_id=#{member} OR g.source_type='GROUP' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.directory_group_member gm WHERE gm.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND gm.group_id=g.group_id AND gm.membership_id=#{member})) AND g.id >#{after} ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 101

SELECT id,operator_ref,operation,target_id,target_version,occurred_at,outcome FROM ( SELECT e.id,e.operator_ref,e.operation,e.target_id,e.target_version,e.occurred_at::text,'COMMITTED' outcome FROM auth_governance.audit_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND e.id >#{after} AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.access_grant g WHERE g.id=e.target_id AND g.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND g.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND g.environment=#{p.environment}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.role_version r WHERE r.id=e.target_id AND r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.access_request r WHERE r.id=e.target_id AND r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.request_policy r WHERE r.id=e.target_id AND r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND r.environment=#{p.environment})) UNION ALL SELECT id,operator_ref,operation,target_id,0 target_version,occurred_at::text,outcome FROM auth_governance.portal_diagnostic_audit WHERE AND id >#{after} ) events ORDER BY id LIMIT 101
